title: Microsoft’s AI chatbot Copilot leaves WhatsApp on January 15
description: WhatsApp's new platform policies ban general-purpose AI chatbots like Copilot from using its service.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Speechify adds voice typing and voice assistant to its Chrome extension
description: In the last 12 months, there has been a proliferation of voice detection tools, thanks to overall quality improvement in speech recognition models. Speechify is hitching its wagon to this train and launching its own dictation tool with support for English.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Google teams up with Accel to hunt for India’s next AI breakouts
description: Google and Accel will jointly invest up to $2 million in each startup through their new partnership.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Altman describes OpenAI’s forthcoming AI device as more peaceful and calm than the iPhone
description: Altman and Ive tease a simple AI device aimed at calm, distraction-free computing, launching within two years.
author: Sarah Perez

title: OpenAI learned the hard way that Cameo trademarked the word ‘cameo’
description: OpenAI might have to rename the "cameo" feature in the Sora app.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Hands on with Stickerbox, the AI-powered sticker maker for kids
description: Stickerbox turns kids’ ideas into printable stickers, blending AI magic with hands-on coloring for a surprisingly creative, "screen-light" play experience.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Grok says Elon Musk is better than basically everyone, except Shohei Ohtani
description: According to Grok, Elon Musk can out-slug the MLB's greatest power hitters... except Ohtani.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Google steps up AI scam protection in India, but gaps remain
description: Google is expanding its real-time scam-detection and screen-sharing fraud warnings in India.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: ChatGPT launches group chats globally
description: The company sees group chats in ChatGPT as a way for people to coordinate trips, co-write documents, settle debates, or work through research together, while ChatGPT helps search, summarize, and compare options.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Mixup is a new, Mad Libs-style app for creating AI images from photos, text, and doodles
description: The new app lets anyone use Google's Nano Banana in a fun new way, with fill-in-the-blank AI "recipes" that users can share.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Gemini 3 refused to believe it was 2025, and hilarity ensued
description: Famed AI researcher Andrej Karpathy got early access to Google’s latest AI model and stumbled onto its "model smell."
author: Julie Bort

title: Gemini starts rolling out to Android Auto globally
description: Gemini will replace Google Assistant and give drivers the ability to make playlists, access email, and learn about a city — all through voice.
author: Aisha Malik

title: The best guide to spotting AI writing comes from Wikipedia
description: Wikipedia's guide to “Signs of AI writing” is a great resource for learning to spot LLM-generated prose.
author: Russell Brandom

title: India’s TCS gets TPG to fund half of $2B AI data center project
description: TCS and private equity firm TPG will invest up to $2 billion to build data centers for AI training and inference in India.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Google releases Nano Banana Pro, its latest image generation model
description: Google is upgrading its image generation model with new editing chops, higher resolutions, more accurate text rendering, and the ability to search the web.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: As its voice dictation app takes off, Wispr secures $25M from Notable Capital
description: Voice AI company Wispr is raising $25 million in funding merely months after its $30 million Series A.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Sortera is turning America’s scrap aluminum problem into cash
description: Sortera has developed an AI-guided system to sort scrap aluminum by specific grades. The startup is building a second sorting facility in Tennessee.
author: Tim De Chant

title: Finland’s NestAI lands €100M, partners with Nokia to build AI for defense applications
description: Finnish startup NestAI said it has raised €100 million to build "Europe's leading physical AI lab."
author: Anna Heim

title: Nvidia’s record $57B revenue and upbeat forecast quiets AI bubble talk
description: Nvidia's earnings were dominated by its data center business.
author: Kirsten Korosec

title: Function Health raises $298M Series B at $2.5B valuation
description: From electronic health records and blood tests to the stream of data from wearable devices, the amount of health information people generate is accelerating rapidly. Yet, many users struggle to connect this trove of data in a meaningful way and actually use it to improve their health. Function Health wants to consolidate health data and make it usable for its customers.
author: Kate Park

title: VC Jennifer Neundorfer explains how founders can stand out in a crowded AI market
description: Founders and investors alike are obsessed with AI, and even Neundorfer said her firm, January Ventures, is looking at ways to use AI to make their work more efficient, such as helping to do due diligence on the market and competition.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis
